verdict.rationale: Postman's Agent Mode explicitly lets users 'turn your words into action across the API lifecycle. Send requests, fix errors, update tests, and more, using natural language,' directly matching the story, and this is reinforced by an official MCP server/gateway that exposes Postman functionality to AI agents via natural-language-driven tool calls. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of Agent Mode's natural-language behavior (only first-party docs), and no community evidence discussing real-world use of NL commands.
